name: 15 - Feedback Loop CTR (sistema aprende com cliques)

parameters.query: SELECT id, kutt_link_id, categoria FROM posts_log WHERE postado_em > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND kutt_link_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE posts_log SET cliques_ultimo_check = {{ $json.cliques }} WHERE id = {{ $json.post_id }}

-- Recalcula performance por categoria com dados dos últimos 7 dias
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    categoria,
    COUNT(*) as posts_totais,
    SUM(cliques_ultimo_check) as cliques_totais,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 
      THEN (SUM(cliques_ultimo_check)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*)) * 100
      ELSE 0 END as ctr_pct
  FROM posts_log
  WHERE postado_em > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND categoria IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY categoria
),
media AS (SELECT AVG(ctr_pct) as media_ctr FROM stats WHERE posts_totais >= 5)
INSERT INTO performance_categoria (categoria, posts_totais, cliques_totais, ctr_pct, boost_score, atualizado_em)
SELECT 
  s.categoria,
  s.posts_totais,
  s.cliques_totais,
  s.ctr_pct,
  -- Boost: se CTR > 2x média = +20, > 1.5x = +15, > 1x = +10, > 0.5x = 0, senão -10
  CASE 
    WHEN s.posts_totais < 5 THEN 0  -- ainda sem dados suficientes
    WHEN s.ctr_pct > COALESCE((SELECT media_ctr FROM media), 0) * 2 THEN 20
    WHEN s.ctr_pct > COALESCE((SELECT media_ctr FROM media), 0) * 1.5 THEN 15
    WHEN s.ctr_pct > COALESCE((SELECT media_ctr FROM media), 0) THEN 10
    WHEN s.ctr_pct > COALESCE((SELECT media_ctr FROM media), 0) * 0.5 THEN 0
    ELSE -10
  END as boost_score,
  NOW()
FROM stats s
ON CONFLICT (categoria) DO UPDATE SET
  posts_totais = EXCLUDED.posts_totais,
  cliques_totais = EXCLUDED.cliques_totais,
  ctr_pct = EXCLUDED.ctr_pct,
  boost_score = EXCLUDED.boost_score,
  atualizado_em = NOW();

meta.description: Feedback loop CTR. Roda 30min: (1) le cliques do Kutt pra cada post ultimos 7 dias, (2) atualiza posts_log, (3) recalcula CTR medio por categoria e calibra boost_score (-10 a +20). Score Engine (12) consulta performance_categoria e aplica boost automatico. Precisa 5+ posts por categoria pra ativar aprendizado. Amadurece em 2-4 semanas.
